title: Term of Office for President and Members of National Commission

content.scenario: The Central Government is framing rules for the National Commission and wants to determine the term of office for its President and members.
content.outcome: The President and members of the National Commission shall hold office for a term not exceeding five years from the date on which they enter upon their office and shall be eligible for re-appointment, subject to age limits of seventy years for the President and sixty-seven years for other members.

user_queries: What is the term of office for the President of the National Commission?
Can members of the National Commission be re-appointed?
What are the age limits for the President and members?
